describe: The image shows a boxy cube-shaped object, a crate or sack seen from three faces: a front face with a large dark round hole with a thin rim, four black triangular markers with white letters W, S, B and H around it, a darker green-grey right side and a light beige top edge. The surface is worn beige-grey canvas or cloth with fine speckles. Lit from the front-left, the right side is in shadow. Transparent background.
